answer: Re-attestations are stored in sable and whisper lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the cipher graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 2025 identities would post 4170 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
